objective: Exploratory exact census with frozen predictions P1-P6. Networks (rings of length 3 to 6, the theta graph, K4, K_{2,3}, the prism, bouquets of triangles) carrying permutation contact: regular links of Z2, Z3, S3, S4 and the cyclic group generated by (01)(234), and random two-valued permutation links. Check that the composite is the common-fixed-point rule (P1); that group contact keeps an amount of memory that depends on the network only through its number of independent loops (P2); that loop-selector shapes are nerves of fixed-point sets, with knots among loops at minimal non-faces and none under free contact (P3); that every complex on at most four vertices is such a shape and a knot among k loops needs k+1 witness values (P4); how the basic, pinned and three-witness affine relaxations over F2, F3, Q and Z, arc consistency and path consistency treat impossible networks (P5); and whether the composite records more than the conjugacy classes of the loop holonomies (P6).
status: Closed: supported by HOLES-COHOMOLOGY-20261019-001A-E001 (exploratory; frozen predictions P1-P6 all hold; controls pass; the independent check verifies all 1,844 certificates by substitution). P1: the composite is the common-fixed-point rule on 38 graph-group pairs and 300 random link assignments. P2: group memory depends only on the number of loops (S3: 2/3, 5/18, 11/108 allowed at 1, 2, 3 loops; Z2, Z3: |G|^-b1). P3: selector shapes are nerves on 23,652 holonomy tuples; every knot among loops is an atom; free contact binds nothing. P4: all 193 complexes on at most 4 vertices occur; a knot among k loops needs k+1 values (k = 2, 3, 4). P5: on 80 instances (34 impossible) the basic level-2 relaxation is fooled exactly when 1 is in the orbit-size ideal (Q 34, F3 27, F2 20, Z 9); pinned level 2, level 3 and path consistency refute all 34. P6: S3 and S4 composites are not functions of the loops' cycle types.
title: Contact networks and local reasoning: an exact census
